title: Police search for teacher who missed sentencing after indecent assault conviction
summary_full: Sally-Anne Bowen was found guilty of having sexual relationships with two pupils at a boys’ school in the 1980sPolice are searching for a missing chemistry teacher convicted of sexual relationships with two pupils at a boys’ school in the late 1980s after she did not turn up to her sentencing hearing.Sally-Anne Bowen, 65, was not found at her Hemel Hempstead home by Metropolitan police officers after her failure to attend Harrow crown court in north London on Friday, where a warrant was issued for her arrest.
